item.title: ISSF World Cup: Anish Wins Silver In Rapid-fire Pistol, His Second WC Final Medal (Ld)
item.description: International Shooting Sport Federation: Rapid Fire Pistol (RFP) champ Anish Bhanwala rounded off a profitable day two for India at the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) World Cup Final (WCF) Rifle/Pistol/Shotgun in Doha, with a silver in the men’s 25m RFP.

item.title: Shepherd’s Final-Over Heroics Seal MI Emirates’ Thrilling Four-Run Win Over Sharjah Warriorz
item.description: MI Emirates edged Sharjah Warriorz by four runs in a thrilling contest, thanks to Romario Shepherd’s outstanding final over and unbeaten 31 off 10 balls

item.title: AIFF Super Cup: FC Thrash East Bengal 6-5 To Claim Third Title
item.description: FC Goa were crowned champions of the AIFF Super Cup for a record third time, after they defeated East Bengal FC 6-5 in a penalty shootout at the PJN Stadium on Sunday.

item.title: Powell’s Blazing 96* Powers Dubai Capitals to Dominant 83-Run Win Over Abu Dhabi Knight Riders
item.description: Rovman Powell’s unbeaten 96 and Jordan Cox’s 52 powered the Dubai Capitals to 187, before their bowlers skittled Abu Dhabi Knight Riders for 103 to seal an 83-run ILT20 win.

item.title: Celta Stun Real Madrid To Leave Barca Clear At Top Of La Liga
item.description: Santiago Bernabeu Stadium: Celta Vigo defeated Real Madrid 2-0 at the Santiago Bernabeu Stadium to leave FC Barcelona four points clear at the top of La Liga.

item.title: Marnus Backs Neser As Australia Faces Selection Headache For Adelaide Test
item.description: Adelaide Test: Australia are prepared to continue to make tough calls at selection on whether or not to pick Michael Neser for the Adelaide Test after his Gabba heroics as they eye a series-clinching victory in the third Ashes Test in Adelaide.

item.title: Dortmund Tighten Top-three Grip After Win Over Hoffenheim
item.description: Borussia Dortmund: Borussia Dortmund produced a controlled, efficient display to secure a 2-0 home win over Hoffenheim, strengthening their hold on a top-three position in the Bundesliga.

item.title: Henry, Smith, Santner Ruled Out Of Remainder Of Test Series Against WI
item.description: New Zealand Cricket: New Zealand have been hit hard by injuries, with Matt Henry, Nathan Smith, and Mitchell Santner ruled out of the remainder of the Test Series against the West Indies, the country's cricket board announced on Monday.

item.title: Junior Women’s Hockey WC: India Clinch 3-1 Victory Over Wales
item.description: FIH Junior Women: Indian Junior women’s team registered a 3-1 win against Wales in their 9/11 qualification match of the FIH Junior Women’s World Cup, held at the Centro Deportivo de Hockey Cesped, Estadio Nacional in Santiago.

item.title: Ashes: ‘Extra Batting Gave Us Balance We Were After,’ Says Smith Explaining Lyon’s Exclusion From Gabba Test
item.description: Gabba Test: Steve Smith explained Australia’s choice to exclude Nathan Lyon from their commanding eight-wicket victory over England in Brisbane, saying the extra batting gave the balance they were looking for and the absence was not linked to his abilities at all.
